producer.description: Designs and hosts the challenge with safety and structure.

observer_broadcaster.description: Watches or rebroadcasts the challenge and brings attention.

target.description: Opt-in participant with a verified need who completes the challenge.

description: The Chance Channel is a dignity-first challenge lane where a producer, observer/broadcaster, and target participate in a non-exploitative challenge. No pity-bait, no tragedy performance, only effort-based value and verified need.
